senses.en: to provide someone with something useful or pleasant
senses.pattern: afford a view of / afford an opportunity / afford protection
senses.example: The hilltop tower [[affords]] visitors a wonderful view of the harbor and the islands beyond.
senses.example_zh: 這座山頂的高塔為遊客提供絕佳視野，可眺望港口與遠處的島嶼。

senses.en: to be able to do something without serious problems
senses.pattern: cannot afford to lose / can't afford a mistake / can ill afford to
senses.example: With the final exam only a week away, we cannot [[afford]] to waste any more time.
senses.example_zh: 期末考只剩一週，我們承擔不起再浪費時間的後果。
senses.note: 多用於否定句：cannot afford to V

senses.en: to give reasons to support or oppose an idea
senses.pattern: argue that… / argue for / argue against
senses.example: Some scientists [[argue]] that sleeping less than six hours a night harms our memory.
senses.example_zh: 有些科學家主張，每晚睡不到六小時會損害我們的記憶力。

gsat.sentence: You might [[argue]] that if working out doesn’t give you pain, it isn’t working.
In making a case for or against zoos, both sides [[argue]] that they’re saving animals.

senses.en: the money left in an account or still owed
senses.pattern: bank balance / check your balance / pay the balance
senses.example: Before buying the concert tickets online, Amy checked the [[balance]] in her bank account.
senses.example_zh: 上網買演唱會門票前，艾咪先查了銀行帳戶的餘額。

senses.en: to compare the importance of two different things
senses.pattern: balance A against B / balance the benefits against the risks / balance costs and benefits
senses.example: Doctors must [[balance]] the benefits of a new drug against its possible side effects.
senses.example_zh: 醫生必須權衡新藥的療效與可能產生的副作用。

senses.en: to start to have an unpleasant effect
senses.pattern: begin to bite / start to bite / bite hard
senses.example: When the higher electricity prices began to [[bite]], many small shops had to shorten their opening hours.
senses.example_zh: 電價上漲開始產生不良影響，許多小店只好縮短營業時間。

senses.en: a small quick meal; a small amount of food
senses.pattern: grab a bite / a bite to eat / have a quick bite
senses.example: We had only twenty minutes before the movie, so we grabbed a quick [[bite]] at a noodle stand.
senses.example_zh: 電影開演前只剩二十分鐘，所以我們在麵攤匆匆吃了簡單的一餐。

senses.en: something that a person has a duty to handle
senses.pattern: make it your business to / none of your business / have no business doing
senses.example: It is a teacher's [[business]] to make sure that every student feels safe in class.
senses.example_zh: 確保每位學生在課堂上感到安全，是老師分內的事。

senses.en: a matter, event, or situation, often a troublesome one
senses.pattern: the whole business / a strange business / an unpleasant business
senses.example: The whole [[business]] of applying for a visa took far longer than we had expected.
senses.example_zh: 申請簽證這整件事情花的時間比我們預期的久得多。

senses.en: a group of shops or hotels owned by one company
senses.pattern: a hotel chain / a fast-food chain / a chain of supermarkets
senses.example: The coffee [[chain]] plans to open thirty new shops near schools and train stations next year.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡連鎖店計畫明年在學校和車站附近開設三十家新門市。

senses.en: a series of connected events or things
senses.pattern: a chain of events / the food chain / a mountain chain / a supply chain
senses.example: A single careless post online set off a [[chain]] of events that nobody could stop.
senses.example_zh: 網路上一則不小心的貼文引發了一連串誰也阻止不了的事件。

gsat.sentence: [[Chains]] have emerged in Taiwan, Singapore, and even on resort islands like Bali.
Desalinating seawater may kill some sea creatures and disturb the food [[chain]].

senses.en: careful and thorough
senses.pattern: pay close attention to / take a close look / on closer examination / keep a close watch on
senses.example: The doctor took a [[close]] look at the X-ray before deciding whether surgery was necessary.
senses.example_zh: 醫生仔細看過 X 光片後，才決定是否需要動手術。

senses.en: (of a contest) won or lost by a small amount
senses.pattern: a close game / a close race / a close contest / too close to call
senses.example: It was such a [[close]] game that the winner was not decided until the final second.
senses.example_zh: 那場比賽勢均力敵，直到最後一秒才分出勝負。

senses.en: the end of a period or activity
senses.pattern: at the close of / come to a close / draw to a close / bring sth to a close
senses.example: As the school year drew to a [[close]], the seniors began cleaning out their lockers.
senses.example_zh: 學年即將結束之際，高三生開始清空自己的置物櫃。

gsat.sentence: Upon [[closer]] examination, de Mestral observed that the burrs, which appeared straight to the naked eye, actually contained many small hooks that clung firmly to the loops in the fabric of his pants.
At the [[close]] of the 15th century, Europeans’ craze for spices gave rise to the Spice Route, a network of sea lanes joining Europe with the Far East, where most spices came from.

senses.en: to form or make up a whole
senses.pattern: be composed of / be composed mainly of / be composed entirely of
senses.example: Water is [[composed]] of hydrogen and oxygen, two gases that are invisible at room temperature.
senses.example_zh: 水由氫和氧組成，這兩種氣體在室溫下都看不見。

senses.en: to make yourself calm and controlled
senses.pattern: compose yourself / compose your thoughts / pause to compose yourself
senses.example: She took a deep breath to [[compose]] herself before walking onto the stage to speak.
senses.example_zh: 她深吸一口氣使自己鎮定下來，然後才走上台演講。

gsat.sentence: The names were chosen from a name pool [[composed]] of 140 names, 10 each from the 14 members of the committee.
The new expansion is [[composed]] of five themed splash pads and a River Boat Adventure Ride.

senses.en: a switch or device used to operate a machine
senses.pattern: at the controls / the volume control / a remote control
senses.example: The pilot stayed at the [[controls]] for ten hours as the plane crossed the stormy ocean.
senses.example_zh: 飛機飛越風暴中的海洋時，飛行員在操縱裝置前守了整整十個小時。

senses.en: a group used for comparison in an experiment
senses.pattern: a control group / serve as a control / a control experiment
senses.example: Half of the plants received extra light, while the other half served as a [[control]].
senses.example_zh: 半數的植物接受額外光照，另一半則作為對照組。

gsat.sentence: He linked all of this to a device shaped like a spinning wheel, with a foot [[control]] that turned the rod, making the glass hemispheres rotate.
Moreover, a number of firms are creating cars that drive themselves to a chosen destination without a human at the [[controls]].

senses.en: a steady flow of water or air
senses.pattern: ocean currents / air currents / a strong current / swim against the current
senses.example: The little paper boat was carried downstream by the [[current]] and soon disappeared from view.
senses.example_zh: 小紙船被水流帶往下游，很快就從視線中消失。

senses.en: a flow of electricity through a wire
senses.pattern: an electric current / a weak current / pass a current through
senses.example: A weak electric [[current]] passes through the wire when both metals touch the lemon juice.
senses.example_zh: 當兩種金屬都碰到檸檬汁時，微弱的電流便會通過電線。

gsat.sentence: During different tides, [[currents]] may change from one direction to the other.
In 2020, Petur Oddsson, a power station worker in Iceland, was struck by a 60,000-volt [[current]].

senses.en: a subject of study, especially at a university
senses.pattern: an academic discipline / a scientific discipline / across disciplines
senses.example: Psychology is a relatively young [[discipline]] compared with mathematics or philosophy.
senses.example_zh: 與數學或哲學相比，心理學是一門相對年輕的學科。

senses.en: to punish or train someone to obey rules
senses.pattern: be disciplined for / discipline a student / discipline one's children
senses.example: Two players were [[disciplined]] by the coach for skipping practice without permission.
senses.example_zh: 兩名球員因未經許可缺席練習而遭教練懲戒。

senses.en: an ability to recognize and copy sounds well
senses.pattern: have an ear for music / a good ear for languages / play by ear
senses.example: With a good [[ear]] for languages, Mia picked up Spanish after only a few months in Madrid.
senses.example_zh: 米雅對語言的辨音力很好，在馬德里才待幾個月就學會了西班牙語。

senses.en: the top part of a grain plant containing seeds
senses.pattern: an ear of corn / ears of wheat / ears of rice
senses.example: The farmer picked a ripe [[ear]] of corn and roasted it over the fire for us.
senses.example_zh: 農夫摘下一根成熟的玉米穗，放在火上烤給我們吃。

senses.en: always; continuously; increasingly
senses.pattern: ever-changing / ever-increasing / ever since / as popular as ever
senses.example: Teachers must keep learning to meet the [[ever]]-growing demands of the digital classroom.
senses.example_zh: 教師必須持續學習，才能因應數位教室不斷增加的要求。

gsat.sentence: By working collectively, the ants are able to improve the efficiency of their network and adapt to their [[ever]]-changing environment.
President Jefferson also opened the house for public tours, and it has remained open, except during wartime, [[ever]] since.

senses.en: firmly and tightly; (asleep) deeply
senses.pattern: fast asleep / hold fast to / be stuck fast
senses.example: The baby was [[fast]] asleep in her mother's arms despite the noise of the crowded station.
senses.example_zh: 儘管擁擠的車站很吵，寶寶仍在媽媽懷裡睡得很熟。

senses.en: to eat no food for a period of time
senses.pattern: fast for twelve hours / fast before a blood test / fast during the holy month
senses.example: Patients are usually asked to [[fast]] for eight hours before this kind of blood test.
senses.example_zh: 做這種抽血檢查前，病人通常被要求禁食八小時。
senses.note: 亦作名詞；breakfast 原指「打破禁食」

senses.en: (of a business) to close because it has failed
senses.pattern: the company folded / fold after two years / be forced to fold
senses.example: The small magazine [[folded]] after only a year because it could not attract enough readers.
senses.example_zh: 這家小雜誌社因為吸引不到足夠的讀者，才成立一年就倒閉了。

senses.en: to cross your arms over your chest
senses.pattern: fold your arms / with arms folded / fold your hands
senses.example: The coach [[folded]] his arms and watched silently as the players argued about the missed goal.
senses.example_zh: 教練雙臂交叉，默默看著球員為那記沒進的球爭論。

gsat.sentence: When people feel uncomfortable or nervous, they may [[fold]] their arms across their chests as if to protect themselves.

senses.en: to understand or believe something from what you hear
senses.pattern: I gather that… / from what I can gather / as far as I can gather
senses.example: I [[gather]] from your email that you would like to change the date of the interview.
senses.example_zh: 從你的電子郵件，我推斷你想更改面試的日期。

senses.en: to gradually increase in speed, force, or strength
senses.pattern: gather speed / gather momentum / gather strength / gather pace
senses.example: The train slowly left the platform and [[gathered]] speed as it headed out of the city.
senses.example_zh: 火車緩緩駛離月台，出城時速度逐漸增加。

senses.en: to make people or animals move together as a group
senses.pattern: herd cattle / herd sheep / herd tourists onto a bus
senses.example: The guide [[herded]] the tired tourists onto the bus before the heavy rain began.
senses.example_zh: 大雨落下之前，導遊把疲憊的遊客全趕上了遊覽車。

senses.en: a large group of people who all behave alike
senses.pattern: follow the herd / herd mentality / herd instinct
senses.example: Instead of following the [[herd]], Lily chose a major that truly interested her.
senses.example_zh: 莉莉不跟隨盲從的群眾，而是選了自己真正感興趣的科系。

senses.en: the first letter of a person's name
senses.pattern: sign your initials / carve your initials / first and middle initials
senses.example: Grandpa carved his [[initials]], T.W., into the tree trunk when he was a boy.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺小時候把自己姓名的首字母 T.W. 刻在樹幹上。

senses.en: to write your initials on a document
senses.pattern: initial each page / initial the changes / initial a contract
senses.example: Please read the contract carefully and [[initial]] the bottom of every page before signing.
senses.example_zh: 請仔細閱讀合約，在每一頁底部簽姓名縮寫後再正式簽名。

gsat.sentence: Norwegians were prohibited from wearing any symbol of their national unity, such as buttons with the [[initials]] of their king.

senses.en: no longer alive; recently dead
senses.pattern: the late poet / her late husband / the late Mr. Brown
senses.example: The museum displays letters written by the [[late]] poet, who died in 1985.
senses.example_zh: 博物館展出這位已故詩人所寫的書信，他於一九八五年過世。

senses.en: near the end of a period of time
senses.pattern: in the late 19th century / in her late twenties / late summer
senses.example: The stone bridge was built in the [[late]] eighteenth century and is still in use today.
senses.example_zh: 這座石橋建於十八世紀晚期，至今仍在使用。

gsat.sentence: The melted bells were recast in the [[late]] 19th century.
The liquid was originally a grape alcohol introduced from France in the [[late]] 14th century.

senses.en: a small bunch of hair
senses.pattern: a lock of hair / curly locks / golden locks
senses.example: The mother kept a [[lock]] of her baby's hair in a small silver box.
senses.example_zh: 那位母親把寶寶的一綹頭髮收藏在一個小銀盒裡。

senses.en: to hold someone in a struggle or fixed position
senses.pattern: be locked in a battle / be locked in a dispute / be locked in talks
senses.example: The two companies have been [[locked]] in a legal battle over the patent for three years.
senses.example_zh: 這兩家公司為了這項專利陷入法律纏鬥已有三年。

senses.en: the study and practice of treating illness
senses.pattern: study medicine / practice medicine / modern medicine / traditional Chinese medicine
senses.example: After studying [[medicine]] for seven years, Kevin finally became a doctor at a children's hospital.
senses.example_zh: 攻讀醫學七年後，凱文終於成為兒童醫院的醫師。

gsat.sentence: There are three branches of [[medicine]].
Jonathan had qualified as a doctor but later gave up the practice of [[medicine]] for full-time writing.

senses.en: to choose someone for a job, position, or honor
senses.pattern: be named captain / name sb as manager / be named player of the year
senses.example: After leading the team to three straight victories, Tina was [[named]] captain of the school volleyball team.
senses.example_zh: 帶領球隊三連勝後，蒂娜被任命為學校排球隊的隊長。

senses.en: a reputation; the opinion people have of someone
senses.pattern: make a name for oneself / a good name / a big name
senses.example: The young chef has made a [[name]] for herself with creative dishes using local vegetables.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕主廚以運用在地蔬菜的創意料理闖出了名聲。

gsat.sentence: Skilled at drawing, he soon made a [[name]] for himself making illustrations for novels, sheet music, magazines, and children’s books.

senses.en: (of a number) that cannot be divided exactly by two
senses.pattern: odd numbers / odd and even / odd-numbered pages
senses.example: Houses on the left side of this street all have [[odd]] numbers, such as 7 and 9.
senses.example_zh: 這條街左側的房子門牌都是奇數號，例如七號和九號。

senses.en: happening or done occasionally; not regular
senses.pattern: odd jobs / at odd moments / the odd mistake
senses.example: During the summer, Ben earned pocket money by doing [[odd]] jobs for his neighbors.
senses.example_zh: 暑假期間，班替鄰居做些零星的雜工來賺零用錢。

senses.en: relating to real things that can be seen or touched
senses.pattern: physical evidence / a physical store / the physical world / a physical book
senses.example: The band's new album is sold online only, and no [[physical]] copies will be released.
senses.example_zh: 這個樂團的新專輯只在網路上販售，不會發行實體版。

senses.en: a medical examination of the whole body
senses.pattern: have a physical / an annual physical / pass a physical
senses.example: All new pilots must pass a strict [[physical]] before they are allowed to fly.
senses.example_zh: 所有新進飛行員都必須通過嚴格的健康檢查，才獲准飛行。

gsat.sentence: Though there is no [[physical]] evidence to support this, the word dakshina “south” in Indian languages also means “right,” suggesting that ancient Indians were oriented toward the east, and therefore south was on their right-hand side.

The feel of a book, the smell, the weight, and the knowledge that a particular book might be more than a hundred years old—all these highlight the importance of preserving the [[physical]] book as a complement to technology.

senses.en: to improve something by making small changes
senses.pattern: polish an essay / polish a speech / polish one's skills / polish up one's English
senses.example: He stayed up late to [[polish]] his speech, cutting weak sentences and adding a stronger ending.
senses.example_zh: 他熬夜潤飾演講稿，刪去無力的句子，並加上更有力的結尾。

senses.en: a high level of skill or style
senses.pattern: lack polish / add polish to a performance / need a little more polish
senses.example: The young band played with plenty of energy, but their performance still lacked [[polish]].
senses.example_zh: 這個年輕樂團演奏得活力十足，但他們的表演仍不夠精湛、純熟。

senses.en: an opinion or attitude about a particular subject
senses.pattern: take a position on / make your position clear / the official position
senses.example: The principal made her [[position]] on cell phones clear: they must stay off during class.
senses.example_zh: 校長清楚表明她對手機的立場：上課時一律關機。

senses.en: the situation that someone is in
senses.pattern: be in a position to do / in a difficult position / put sb in an awkward position
senses.example: Having just lost his job, Mark was in no [[position]] to lend money to anyone.
senses.example_zh: 馬克剛失業，以他的處境根本無法借錢給任何人。
senses.note: be in no position to V＝無法…

gsat.sentence: Since I do not fully understand your proposal, I am not in the [[position]] to make any comment on it.

senses.en: a play, film, or show made for the public
senses.pattern: a stage production / a school production / a new production of
senses.example: Our drama club's [[production]] of a classic fairy tale drew a full house on both nights.
senses.example_zh: 我們話劇社演出的經典童話作品，兩晚都座無虛席。

gsat.sentence: The musical has been performed in more than nine languages, with more [[productions]] than any other musical.

senses.en: to judge the quality or value of something
senses.pattern: be rated as / rate sth highly / rate sth on a scale of one to ten
senses.example: Most viewers [[rated]] the documentary as the best program shown on television this year.
senses.example_zh: 多數觀眾把這部紀錄片評定為今年電視上播出的最佳節目。

senses.en: a fixed amount of money charged for something
senses.pattern: room rates / an hourly rate / at a lower rate / special rates
senses.example: The hotel offers a special [[rate]] for students who stay more than three nights.
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店為住宿超過三晚的學生提供特別優惠的價格。

gsat.sentence: Teens [[rated]] Hilfiger jeans as their number one brand in a survey in 2000.
Calls within an area code and often a small group of neighboring area codes are normally charged at a lower [[rate]] than outside the area code.

senses.en: a feeling of doubt about a plan or idea
senses.pattern: have reservations about / express reservations / without reservation
senses.example: I still have some [[reservations]] about the plan, but I am willing to give it a try.
senses.example_zh: 我對這項計畫仍有些疑慮，但願意試試看。

senses.en: an area of land kept for Native Americans
senses.pattern: live on a reservation / a Native American reservation / grow up on a reservation
senses.example: The writer grew up on a [[reservation]] in Arizona and often writes about tribal traditions.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家在亞利桑那州的原住民保留區長大，常書寫部落傳統。

gsat.sentence: The woman told the truth to her lawyer without [[reservation]] because he was the only person she could rely on.

senses.en: to be in charge of a business or organization
senses.pattern: run a business / run a company / run a restaurant / run an office
senses.example: My uncle [[runs]] a small bakery that has served the neighborhood for over twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔經營一家小麵包店，已經為街坊服務了二十多年。

senses.en: to be a candidate in an election
senses.pattern: run for president / run for office / run for mayor / run against sb
senses.example: Emma decided to [[run]] for student council president and began preparing her campaign speech.
senses.example_zh: 艾瑪決定競選學生會主席，並開始準備競選演說。

senses.en: to continue or be shown for a period of time
senses.pattern: run for two years / run until March / run for three weeks
senses.example: The art exhibition will [[run]] until the end of March, so there is still time to see it.
senses.example_zh: 這場藝術展將持續到三月底，所以還有時間去參觀。

gsat.sentence: Jane is the best assistant I have ever had. I cannot imagine [[running]] my office without her help.
Z: Ari will be a superagent [[running]] the same company.

senses.en: to officially take away illegal goods or property
senses.pattern: seize drugs / seize smuggled goods / seize assets
senses.example: Customs officers [[seized]] over two hundred rare turtles hidden in a traveler's suitcases.
senses.example_zh: 海關人員查扣了藏在一名旅客行李箱中的兩百多隻稀有烏龜。

senses.en: to take control of something suddenly by force
senses.pattern: seize power / seize control of / seize the city
senses.example: The rebels [[seized]] control of the capital and forced the king to leave the country.
senses.example_zh: 叛軍奪取了首都的控制權，並迫使國王離開國家。

gsat.sentence: During World War II, Japan [[seized]] much of Southeast Asia’s rubber.
This was to ensure that no single and powerful noble family could [[seize]] the title and pass it to the next generation.

senses.en: something seen, or a place worth seeing
senses.pattern: see the sights / a common sight / a familiar sight / tourist sights
senses.example: We spent our first day in Rome seeing the [[sights]], including the ancient stadium.
senses.example_zh: 我們在羅馬的第一天都在參觀名勝，包括那座古老的競技場。
senses.note: 作「名勝」解時用複數 sights

senses.en: to suddenly see something, especially something looked for
senses.pattern: sight land / sight a whale / be sighted off the coast
senses.example: After weeks at sea, the sailors finally [[sighted]] land on the horizon.
senses.example_zh: 在海上航行數週後，水手們終於看見了地平線上的陸地。

gsat.sentence: For two weeks he filled his sketchbook with the landscape’s most stunning [[sights]].
Street pigeons are a common [[sight]] in many European cities.

senses.en: to make something dirty
senses.pattern: soil your clothes / soiled diapers / soil your hands
senses.example: Wear an apron while painting so that you don't [[soil]] your school uniform.
senses.example_zh: 畫畫時請穿上圍裙，以免弄髒學校制服。

senses.en: a country's land or territory
senses.pattern: on foreign soil / on home soil / on Japanese soil
senses.example: It was the first time the team had ever won a championship on foreign [[soil]].
senses.example_zh: 這是該隊第一次在外國的國土上贏得冠軍。

gsat.sentence: Whenever I set foot on the [[soil]] of Rwanda, a country in east-central Africa, I feel as if I have entered paradise: green hills, red earth, sparkling rivers and mountain lakes.

senses.en: to provide the workers for an organization
senses.pattern: be staffed by volunteers / staff the front desk / fully staffed
senses.example: The new community clinic will be [[staffed]] by two doctors and six experienced nurses.
senses.example_zh: 新的社區診所將配備兩名醫師和六名資深護理師。

senses.en: a continuous area of land or period of time
senses.pattern: a stretch of road / a stretch of coastline / for long stretches / at a stretch
senses.example: This [[stretch]] of the river is popular with families because the water is shallow and calm.
senses.example_zh: 這一段河流很受家庭歡迎，因為水淺而平靜。

senses.en: to spread over a large area or long time
senses.pattern: stretch for miles / stretch from A to B / stretch back to
senses.example: Rice fields [[stretch]] as far as the eye can see on both sides of the railway.
senses.example_zh: 鐵路兩側的稻田一路綿延，一望無際。

senses.en: to use nearly all of someone's money or resources
senses.pattern: be stretched to the limit / stretch the budget / be stretched thin
senses.example: The sudden flood of patients [[stretched]] the small hospital's resources to the limit.
senses.example_zh: 突然湧入的病患使這家小醫院的資源吃緊到了極限。

gsat.sentence: Now, however, men have developed huge fishing nets that form underwater “walls” that [[stretch]] for miles.
With a continuous 3 km [[stretch]] of golden sand, the beach attracts artists around the world each summer to create amazing sculptures with its fine soft sand.

senses.en: to use rude or offensive language
senses.pattern: swear at sb / swear loudly / stop swearing
senses.example: The player was sent off the field for [[swearing]] at the referee during the match.
senses.example_zh: 那名球員因在比賽中咒罵裁判而被罰出場。

senses.en: a strong trend, or a growing amount of something unpleasant
senses.pattern: the tide of public opinion / turn the tide / a rising tide of / go against the tide
senses.example: The [[tide]] of public opinion has turned against single-use plastic in recent years.
senses.example_zh: 近年來，輿論的潮流已轉向反對一次性塑膠。

senses.en: to help someone get through a difficult period
senses.pattern: tide sb over / tide sb over until payday / enough to tide us over
senses.example: His sister lent him some money to [[tide]] him over until he found a new job.
senses.example_zh: 他姊姊借他一些錢，幫他度過找到新工作前的難關。
senses.note: 須與 over 連用：tide sb over

gsat.sentence: Both issues result from the [[tide]] of violence that has crossed the region in recent years.

senses.en: to make someone feel worried or upset
senses.pattern: be troubled by / what troubles me is / a troubled look
senses.example: What [[troubles]] the coach most is that several players have stopped believing in themselves.
senses.example_zh: 最使教練煩惱的是，有幾名球員已不再相信自己。

senses.en: a problem with the body or a machine
senses.pattern: heart trouble / back trouble / stomach trouble / engine trouble
senses.example: My grandfather has had heart [[trouble]] for years and sees his doctor every month.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺多年來一直有心臟方面的毛病，每個月都要看醫生。

gsat.sentence: Amir was very much [[troubled]] by the donkey’s trick, but did not know what to do.
The country has been [[troubled]] by a problem with trains colliding with deer on its railways.

senses.en: a lack of something; the state of being poor
senses.pattern: for want of / for want of a better word / live in want
senses.example: Many young trees in the park died for [[want]] of water during the long dry summer.
senses.example_zh: 在漫長乾燥的夏天，公園裡許多小樹因缺乏水分而枯死。

senses.en: (of the police) to be searching for a suspect
senses.pattern: be wanted by the police / be wanted for robbery / a wanted man
senses.example: The man is [[wanted]] by police in three countries for stealing valuable paintings.
senses.example_zh: 那名男子因偷竊名貴畫作而遭三國警方通緝。

senses.en: to be effective or produce the intended result
senses.pattern: the plan worked / work well / work wonders
senses.example: I tried several ways to remove the ink stain, but none of them [[worked]].
senses.example_zh: 我試了好幾種方法去除墨漬，但沒有一種奏效。

senses.en: a book, painting, or piece of music
senses.pattern: a work of art / the complete works of / literary works
senses.example: The library holds the complete [[works]] of the poet, including her early unpublished letters.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館收藏了這位詩人的全部作品，包括她早期未發表的書信。

gsat.sentence: If that [[works]], human trials will be next on the agenda.
It was the only national park established because of Moran’s [[works]].

quiz.stem: Although the new exam policy sounds promising, several teachers have expressed serious ______ about whether it can actually reduce students' stress.
quiz.explain_zh: reservation＝疑慮、保留意見。幾位老師對新政策能否減輕學生壓力深表疑慮。

quiz.stem: Unable to compete with large online stores, the small bookshop near our school finally ______ last month after forty years in business.
quiz.explain_zh: fold＝倒閉、停業。小書店不敵大型網路商店，上個月結束營業。

quiz.stem: Lifeguards warned the swimmers to stay near the shore because a powerful ______ could easily carry them far out to sea.
quiz.explain_zh: current＝水流。強勁的水流可能輕易把泳客帶到外海。

quiz.stem: Thanks to her outstanding leadership at last year's science fair, Ms. Lin was ______ head of the school's new research program.
quiz.explain_zh: name＝任命。林老師因領導能力出色，被任命為新研究計畫的負責人。

quiz.stem: The concert was held in memory of the ______ conductor, who had led the city orchestra for thirty years before his death in 2010.
quiz.explain_zh: late＝已故的。這場音樂會是為了紀念那位已故的指揮而舉辦。

quiz.stem: From the way Ms. Chen kept looking at her watch, I ______ that she was in a hurry to leave the meeting.
quiz.explain_zh: gather＝推斷。看陳老師頻頻看錶，我推斷她急著離開會議。

quiz.stem: Solving climate problems requires experts from many different ______, including chemistry, economics, and engineering, to work together.
quiz.explain_zh: discipline＝學科。解決氣候問題需要化學、經濟等不同學科的專家合作。

quiz.stem: Although e-books are cheaper and easier to carry, many readers still prefer a ______ book that they can hold, smell, and put on a shelf.
quiz.explain_zh: physical＝實體的。許多讀者仍偏好能拿在手上、擺上書架的實體書。

quiz.stem: The information booth at the night market is ______ by college volunteers who can answer tourists' questions in English, Japanese, and Korean.
quiz.explain_zh: staff＝為…配備人員。夜市服務台由會說多國語言的大學生志工駐守。

quiz.stem: Drivers are advised to slow down on this ______ of the highway, where thick fog often appears without warning in winter.
quiz.explain_zh: stretch＝一段（路程）。這一段公路冬天常突然起濃霧，駕駛應減速。
